items.title: South Korea
kv: The new AML rule requires reporting for transfers of at least KRW 10 million to overseas VASPs or personal wallets. In H1, travel-rule transfers were 15 percent and allowlisted overseas-provider or personal-wallet channels 83 percent of measured external-transfer routes. BOK found a stablecoin/FX transmission mechanism in other fiat markets but not the same significant Korean effect because the studied Binance won pair was absent. The Korea-Indonesia QR link is live conventional retail connectivity.
Aggregate channel share is not beneficial ownership, illicit use, capital flight or a completed stablecoin-to-bank cross-border payment; reporting is not prohibition or public route transparency.

items.title: European Union
kv: EU passporting and euro infrastructure are multinational, and Project Agorá tested a €10,000 treasury payment involving Lloyds, Deutsche Bank, CaixaBank and the Eurosystem. Across Agorá, 23 financial institutions and five central banks ran 17 scenarios in six currencies with about CHF 800,000 of real value and an average initiation-to-settlement time of one minute 20 seconds. The platform triggered movements in existing core bank systems rather than issuing a common production deposit token. Deutsche Bank also participates in Partior and describes future tokenized-deposit connectivity, but route-specific production receipts remain open.

A controlled real-value test is stronger than simulation but is not recurring production; platform messages, customer debits, correspondent funding, FX, central-bank settlement and beneficiary credit remain separate records.

cells.text: ANZ, BHP, Citi and Swift completed live USD corporate-treasury payments between Melbourne and New York using tokenized deposits while the customer retained its ordinary ANZ account and channel. Swift's general architecture uses bank-specific tokenized-deposit records and a shared orchestration ledger before final settlement through existing systems. Swift later reported aggregate use across six continents and five currencies. The notices do not disclose value, exact legal entities, correspondent or reserve accounts, FX, final-system entries, beneficiary-credit time, recurring volume or exceptions.

cells.text: Directive 9 carries travel-rule information for covered domestic and cross-border transfers; existing FinSurv rules govern allowances and exchange control; and the August 2026 Crypto Assets Manual proposes a future authorized-CASP framework. Its 30 September comment deadline passed without a reviewed final instrument by the cutoff. Standard Bank's Aroko is genuine recurring blockchain-enabled cross-border bank processing with more than R1 trillion since inception, but its public description is an automated conventional FX-payment and standing-settlement-instruction rail, not a stablecoin or crypto transfer. Nedbank's ZAR/USDC route is announced and conditional, not yet supported by a production receipt. None proves a crypto country-pair route through payer, beneficiary, funding, FX, token transfer, final receipt, failure and correction.

cells.text: Payment Connect is a conventional FPS-to-Mainland real-time remittance link. Ensemble has conducted or planned sandbox and CBDC-infrastructure experiments with France, Brazil and Thailand. HSBC's production Tokenised Deposit Service completed a Hong Kong-Singapore transaction in 2025 and HSBC and Standard Chartered completed the first live cross-border tokenised-deposit interoperability transaction on Swift's blockchain ledger in August 2026, but the obligations were matched and netted before final settlement through existing systems. HKDAP's first trade-finance transaction and B2B use cases demonstrate token settlement but do not disclose a fully joined country-pair route. Circle and Tazapay describe a CPN capability that can receive USDC, convert it to HKD or USD and push funds to local Hong Kong banks, but do not identify a completed Canadian-origin transaction, local payout legal person, beneficiary credit or final-money record. No complete recurring crypto corridor is joined end to end.

cells.text: The China-UAE joint statement records an AED 50 million first direct Digital Dirham payment through mBridge by June 2024; the November 2025 Jisr event was a later launch and transaction demonstration. Bank evidence goes beyond platform signatures: BOC completed the first batch of CBETS cross-border retail transactions for Singapore customers and says BOCHK became the first offshore e-CNY custodian; ICBC and CCB each report a first China-Singapore e-CNY application; BoCom reports CBETS direct-participant agreements for its Hong Kong, Macao and Brazil entities and a Malaysia inbound-wallet solution; PSBC reports online and offline mBridge enterprise use. Payment Connect is a production conventional fiat comparator. Public evidence still does not complete payer/payee identity, funding, FX, both currency legs, beneficiary credit, legal finality, correction or recurring bilateral volume for any one route.

cells.text: The Ghana-Rwanda licence-passporting framework was signed in February 2025, approved in October 2025 and piloted with two PSPs from each country. It establishes a permission pathway but does not identify the firms, exact permissions or a completed payment.
